desc: Derive the complement-subset transformation and verify it for both \(K\le N/2\) and \(K>N/2\).
Establish that the number of reduced-size combinations is at most \(10^6\).
Implement input parsing, combination enumeration, XOR accumulation, maximum tracking, and output formatting in Python.
Validate duplicate values, \(K=1\), \(K=N\), all-zero values, and \(N=1\).
Confirm runtime is acceptable under the \(10^6\)-combination bound.
